title: Browser 2.0
noBrowserHint: Neither Helena's browser nor a project browser is available here.
noAgents: No agent of this browser has the project browser. Turn it on under the agent's tools.

noKey.title: Jev key missing – add it in Access
noKey.body: Standard works without a key. For Jev, add a decision model under Access & connections → Credentials, with one of these:
noKey.typesafe: TypeSafe console: create a key (Jev direct)
noKey.vercel: Vercel AI Gateway: an AI Gateway key, model typesafe-ai/jev

connection.cloudNote: What Helena asks it to decide about, such as the visible text of a page or a mail, goes to this service. Passwords and typed values do not.
connection.localNote: A server of your own that speaks System One. Helena reaches it only at this address.
connection.localModelNote: An OpenAI-compatible server with logprobs (llama.cpp, Lemonade, vLLM). Helena reaches it only at this address.
connection.allowPrivateHint: Helena normally never calls addresses in your network. This allows exactly this address, nothing else.
connection.localAiKey: Address, key and model come from Helena's local AI (Administrator → Local AI, switch on "Decisions" there); nothing to enter here.
connection.keyHintVercel: An AI Gateway key from your Vercel team.
connection.keyHintCompatible: Only if your server asks for one.
connection.keySourceStored: Store a key in this connection
connection.keyCredentialHint: Helena reads the current key from this credential for each request. Rotate it there once. Only API keys from this team and the same project (or the whole team) can be used. No key is copied or disclosed to agents.
connection.keySourceUnavailable: No matching API key is available, or the saved source is no longer accessible. Choose a valid source or check credentials.

codes.address_not_allowed: this address is in your network; allow it for this connection first

control.title: Browser control
control.hint: How this project's agents work in the browser: step by step with their own model, or multi-step tasks handed to a fast decision model (browser_task).
control.connectionMissing: The chosen connection no longer exists. The agents work as in Standard until you choose another.
control.noConnection: No decision model set up yet.
control.policyHint: Automatic picks the way that fits the service.
control.thresholdHint: Below it the task goes back to the agent. Empty uses the way's own value.
control.defaultHint: What a project gets that keeps "As in the defaults". A team's connection applies to that team's projects.
control.modeHint: Standard: agents click step by step. Decision model: agents may hand multi-step browser work to browser_task.
control.connectionHint: Set up under Access & connections → Credentials.

form.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Search for "Helena" and open the first result
form.valuesHint: One per line, name: value. Values are typed but never sent to the decision model.
form.startUrlPlaceholder: optional, else the page that is open
form.jevBrowserNote: jev-browser runs in a browser of its own without your logins, for comparison. It needs a start address.

run.finalFrame: The page at the end of the run
